outcome_contract.planned_risk_r: cost-adjusted entry minus cost-adjusted planned stop
outcome_contract.stop_gap_fill: worse of stop and observed bar open
outcome_contract.target: session VWAP fixed at the completed trigger decision bar
outcome_contract.target_gap_fill: target price without favorable gap improvement

selection_contract.daily_selection: earliest executable entry; ties use deeper armed VWAP deviation then lexical symbol
selection_contract.miss_policy: an invalid target or stop remains in the denominator; a later executable symbol may be selected
selection_contract.session_vwap: cumulative sum(bar WAP times volume) divided by cumulative volume through each completed bar
selection_contract.simple_rsi: 100 minus 100 divided by one plus mean positive change over mean absolute negative change; five completed close changes
selection_contract.trigger: a later bullish completed close above the prior bar high while still below session VWAP
selection_contract.washout_arm: completed close at least 0.75 percent below session VWAP with simple five-change RSI at or below 25

source_selection.date_rule: all locally cached dates with the exact dataset for both symbols
